_help: Windows version (10-page turntable) — see 3d-model.linux-macos.json for a simpler single-angle Linux/macOS version. Renders 3D models with F3D to a 640x480 PNG with a transparent background. --no-config ignores any personal f3d config so thumbnails stay consistent. STEP/IGES are handled by 3d-model-step.json / 3d-model-iges.json instead: f3d 3.5.0 can't auto-detect the occt reader from those extensions alone (fails with "unknown format... use --force-reader"), so they need their own --force-reader value, which can't be shared with the other extensions here. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_args: F3D can also read DXF (via assimp), but mostly 3D DXF, not 2D drawings, so dxf is left out here. Remote (sftp://) files can't be read by f3d and fall back to the icon.
_help_paging: 10 pages turning the model around its Z axis: --up=+Z makes Z the up axis, and %ANGLE% is 0, 36, 72 ... 324 degrees for pages 1-10 (PageUp/PageDown in Quick Look). Models authored Y-up (glTF by spec) will lie on their side with --up=+Z.
